summary: Every installation reports its setup steps to Invardia, so all installations can be kept the same.

fixes.title: Setup steps are reported to Invardia
fixes.text: Every install reports its one-time setup steps to Invardia from a real check on every update, so all installs can be kept the same.

fixes.title: As-built report storage respects your policy
fixes.text: Where a tenant policy forbids public access, the as-built report storage is created private, and a refusal no longer stops the rest of the setup.

fixes.title: No more could-not-check message
fixes.text: The updater no longer says it could not check the engine permissions.
